elements.requirement: A written statement to the effect that wages of any amount have been paid to a person during any period, which purports to be signed by or on behalf of that person's employer, shall serve as evidence of the facts stated within it.
elements.quote: A statement in writing to the effect that wages of any amount have been paid to a person during any period, purporting to be signed by or on behalf of his employer, shall be evidence of the facts therein stated

elements.requirement: The evidentiary written statement of wages paid is admissible in any proceedings before a magistrates’ court for enforcing payment by the person stated to have received the wages of a sum adjudged to be paid by a summary conviction or order.
elements.quote: in any proceedings taken before a magistrates’ court— (a) for enforcing payment by the person to whom the wages are stated to have been paid of a sum adjudged to be paid by a summary conviction or order
